selection_firewall.candidate_origin: mechanistic-class gap search; no predicted-versus-observed residual was calculated before gate adjudication

records.candidate_family: gas-phase chlorine-atom abstraction of hydrogen from methane
records.classification_basis: The primary theory source explicitly treats abstraction of one hydrogen atom from methane by atomic chlorine; this is an atom-transfer event and is mechanistically distinct from the frozen SO2+ + CO oxygen-atom-transfer family.

barrier_quantity.type: QCISD(T) zero-point-energy-corrected barrier height relative to separated Cl + CH4 reactants
barrier_quantity.ccsd_t_crosscheck: CCSD(T) barrier results reported within 0.1 kcal/mol of the QCISD(T) results
barrier_quantity.geometry_level: MP2 with a large TZ+2P basis for the transition-state geometry

source.authors: Kerwin D. Dobbs and David A. Dixon
source.title: Ab Initio Prediction of the Activation Energy for the Abstraction of a Hydrogen Atom from Methane by Chlorine Atom

barrier_quantity.typing_caveat: This is an adiabatic/ZPE-corrected barrier height, not a 298 K Gibbs activation free energy and not an Arrhenius activation energy derived from the comparator rate.

observed_comparator.type: direct experimental gas-phase second-order rate coefficient represented by the primary measured temperature fit

source.authors: Mikhail G. Bryukov, Irene R. Slagle, and Vadim D. Knyazev
source.title: Kinetics of Reactions of Cl Atoms with Methane and Chlorinated Methanes

observed_comparator.representative_rate_origin: evaluated from the primary experimental fit only after source, barrier, classification, condition, and independence gates were specified; numerical residual is non-voting

condition_mapping.composition: Cl + CH4 on both barrier and kinetic sides
condition_mapping.electronic_state: The kinetic comparator measures the chlorine-atom reaction; the coordinate is restricted to the ground-state H-abstraction channel rather than Cl* quenching chemistry.
condition_mapping.temperature: The barrier is a temperature-independent ZPE-corrected PES threshold, while the observed rate is explicitly evaluated inside the directly measured 295-1104 K range at 298.15 K. The barrier is not relabeled as a 298.15 K free energy.
condition_mapping.pressure: The theoretical barrier is an isolated bimolecular potential-energy quantity. The comparator is a direct second-order elementary-reaction coefficient measured at 1.4-8.8 Torr; no third-body association/falloff channel is being mapped onto this coordinate.
condition_mapping.standard_state: number-density second-order kinetics retained in cm^3 molecule^-1 s^-1; no solution-standard-state conversion is applied

independence_basis: The barrier calculation was published in 1994; the selected direct kinetic comparator was published in 2002, so the 2002 target rate could not have been used to fit the 1994 barrier calculation.
The 1994 barrier is an ab initio electronic-structure result, not a rate-derived activation quantity.
The family is hydrogen-atom abstraction from methane by neutral atomic chlorine, distinct from the frozen MC14 SO2+ + CO oxygen-atom-transfer family.
No method variant was selected using the size or sign of a predicted-versus-observed residual.
records.representation_basis: The coordinate is the direct H-atom abstraction channel through the reported transition-state barrier; no competing product network is collapsed into an effective scalar rate. Electronic-state/quenching chemistry is explicitly excluded from this coordinate.
notes: READY_FOR_ADJUDICATION is not coordinate admission and does not assign or change a Barrier Atlas grade.

The 2002 paper also constructs a separate transition-state-theory model using experimental information; that fitted model is not used here. Only its direct experimental kinetic measurements are used as the comparator.
The barrier quantity and observed rate remain physically different quantity types and are not converted into one another to create artificial independence.
